episodes.title: How We Set Up Acharya for Your Coaching — Live in 2 Working Days | Onboarding
episodes.description:
How does Acharya go live for your coaching? This short walkthrough shows exactly how we onboard a coaching institute or an individual teacher — and get your own AI tutor live in just 2 working days.

What you share with us:
• Your coaching / institute name, your name, your subject & full syllabus, and your timeline to finish it
• Your student list — each student's name, WhatsApp number & preferred language (Hindi / English)

What we handle:
• We build your branded system — and if you don't have a domain, we create one for you, free
• Your students learn on the web app AND WhatsApp, under your own name and logo
• You get an admin account (WhatsApp or web — your choice) plus a visual dashboard to monitor and control your whole batch from one place

⏱ Live in 2 working days, once we have your syllabus, student list & timeline.
Keep these handy too, for the best results: your notes, past test papers, your weekly timetable, and the target exam & date.

👉 Start now: https://acharya.trigunai.com/

Built for coaching institutes, tuition centres, and individual teachers — NEET, JEE, boards, and more.
